sign: Seat of the Tallow Choir. A candle for every soul the moor takes. Prices on request.
West: the Breathing Bog. East: Candle Causeway. North: the Wick Rift. The Choir Loft: the waxed door.

lines: Chandler Nurse Ysolde: Rest by the wax. It keeps you warm, and it keeps count.
Choir Clerk Tibb: Tonics and tapers. A taper with your name on it is half price if you buy it before you need it.

lines: Wick Trimmer Aldous: I trim the wicks so the candles last. The Choir docks my pay for every one that lasts too long.
Chorister Marisol: We sing one verse per candle. Some nights we are hoarse by supper.
Grandam Ivy: My candle has been burning for sixty years. Maudrey keeps asking when I'm going to be polite and finish.
